Installation of Reverse Osmosis (RO) Plant after Efﬂuent Treatment Plant (ETP) for wastewater recycling and reuse

An RO plant has been installed downstream of the Efﬂuent Treatment Plant (ETP) to further treat the treated efﬂuent. The RO system produces high-quality recycled water, which is reused in the manufacturing process, thereby reducing dependence on freshwater sources. The system is regularly monitored to ensure compliance with internal quality standards and efﬁcient plant performance.
